[F75Supply of articles for administering or preparing controlled drugs
6A.—(1) Notwithstanding the provisions of section 9A(1) and (3) of the Act, any of the persons
specified in paragraph (2) may, when acting in their capacity as such, supply or offer to supply the
following articles—
(a) a swab;
(b) utensils for the preparation of a controlled drug;
(c) citric acid;
(d) a filter;
(e) ampoules of water for injection, only when supplied or offered for supply in accordance
with the Medicines Act 1968 and of any instrument which is in force thereunder
